jobs.mission: Trace durable history/artifacts for the television/display lane, identify the actual unfinished outcome and exact source bytes if they exist, then create a bounded successor job. Do not guess the product from the label alone.

latest_return.summary: Recovered the durable Tele intent without rebuilding: the historical Guia Autonoma architecture defines this lane as native control of applications, windows and video playback on a secondary display/television connected over HDMI. Targeted Drive searches for HDMI, pantalla secundaria, Fitbit Versa and n8n HDMI converge on that architecture document; current-main repository code searches for HDMI and Fitbit Versa returned no implementation matches. Exact host-side Tele implementation bytes, current display identity/session and any live control workflow therefore remain SOURCE_DEBT rather than being inferred. A bounded read-only host/display baseline successor is justified by the recovered requirement.

jobs.title: Verificar físicamente el remote room actual de Tele
jobs.mission: Probar el experimento room-based actual con el display y un controlador real: QR/pairing, layout/focus, overlay, media, refresh y retorno de tv.state. No promover Human Accepted ni Served; registrar fallas exactas.
definition_of_done: QR/pairing conecta un controlador real con el display o queda un boundary reproducible.
layout/focus/overlay/media/refresh se prueban extremo a extremo.
tv.state vuelve al remoto y refleja el estado visible.
Se registra autoplay/iframe/network boundary sin convertirlo en falso fallo de producto.
No se promueve Human Accepted/Served automáticamente.

jobs.title: Resolver SOURCE_DEBT del host HDMI sin mutar pantalla
jobs.mission: Cerrar el SOURCE_DEBT del linaje HDMI identificando host/sesión/output y primitivas existentes mediante introspección estrictamente read-only. No mover ventanas, reproducir media, instalar paquetes ni cambiar configuración.
definition_of_done: Host objetivo y tipo de sesión gráfica identificados o boundary exacto.
Displays conectados y endpoint secundario/HDMI enumerados sin mutación.
Primitivas/scripts existentes inventariados con paths/versiones/hashes cuando existan.
Si no hay acceso, SOURCE_DEBT queda explícito; no se reconstruye desde memoria.

jobs.title: Verify existing Tele host/display baseline read-only
jobs.mission: Verify the existing host-side baseline for the recovered Tele requirement before any implementation: identify the actual target host/session and secondary display/HDMI endpoint from durable or read-only runtime evidence, recover exact existing display-control scripts/workflows/primitives if present, and record SOURCE_DEBT where access or bytes are absent. Do not move windows, launch media, install dependencies, alter display configuration or design a new Tele UI in this job.
definition_of_done: The actual target host/session and secondary display/HDMI endpoint are identified from durable or read-only runtime evidence, or exact access SOURCE_DEBT is recorded without guessing.

Any existing Tele/display scripts, workflow exports, executables, configs or control primitives are enumerated with exact paths plus versions/hashes where obtainable; absence is reported only within the searched scope.
Read-only detection is used exclusively; no display state, window placement, media playback, package set or system configuration is changed.
Historical Guia Autonoma architecture choices are treated as intent evidence, not silently promoted to Current implementation.
If implementation work becomes justified, its successor is bounded to observed primitives and current authority rather than a redesign from memory.
